ALPACA_EVIDENCE.summary: Direct host/route/status/timestamp/count observations survive. Exact Basic credential identity and a hard 30-channel ceiling remain limited/unproven; fresh IEX premarket was disproven by stale records.

FINVIZ_EVIDENCE.summary: Four isolated first-page access/count/schema observations survive. Exact 04:00 boundary, full paging/universe, and real-time entitlement do not.

SCHWAB_EVIDENCE.summary: The final API response is real but followed a shared OAuth replacement and contained no post-20:00 quote or candle. This campaign did not prove Schwab overnight market-data capability.

rerunPlan.smallestRemainingExperiment: Before assigning Schwab a true-overnight role, run one bounded credential/dependency-fingerprinted read-only Schwab quote-plus-candle probe after 20:05 ET and require provider timestamps after 20:00 ET. Separately, only if code will hardcode an Alpaca Basic websocket ceiling, run one credential-slot/blob-fingerprinted 31-subscription rejection probe. The existing provider-neutral Alpaca research-context architecture does not need a new full-day campaign.

sevenAnswers.smallestRemainingExperiment: One fingerprinted read-only Schwab post-20:05 ET quote/candle probe before assigning Schwab an overnight role; one separate 31-subscription Alpaca probe only if a hard ceiling must be encoded.
